title: Entender un horario sencillo de trabajo
scenario: Comprender turnos y horarios básicos en un entorno laboral

content.studentInstructions: Mira el horario, reconoce días y horas, y completa frases muy cortas sobre tu turno.
content.teacherNotes: Recurso foundation para alumnado con lagunas de base. Prioriza éxito rápido: lectura de tabla, días de la semana, horas y frases modelo.

sections.title: Horario
sections.body: Monday 9:00-13:00, Tuesday 16:00-20:00, Wednesday day off, Thursday 9:00-13:00, Friday 10:00-14:00.
tasks: Circle the days you work in the morning.
Write: I work on Monday from 9 to 1.
Write: Wednesday is my day off.

sections.title: Sentence builder
sections.body: I work on ___ from ___ to ___. I start at ___. I finish at ___. My day off is ___.

answerKey: Accept short answers with correct day and time.
